cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace python -c "
from boltons.listutils import BarrelList

bl = BarrelList(range(100000))

print('sublists:', len(bl.lists), 'len:', len(bl))
ref = list(range(100000)); ref.pop(50000)

try:
    bl[len(bl)]
    raise SystemExit('FAIL: bl[len] did not raise')
except IndexError:
    print('ok: bl[len] raises IndexError')

b = BarrelList(range(100000)); b.pop(50000)
r = list(range(100000)); r.pop(50000)
assert b.pop() == r.pop() == 99999, (b.pop(), r.pop())
assert list(b) == r, 'content mismatch after pop()'
print('ok: pop() end')

assert b.pop(len(b)-1) == r.pop(len(r)-1) == 99998
assert list(b) == r
print('ok: pop(len-1)')

b.insert(len(b), 'X'); r.insert(len(r), 'X')
assert list(b) == r and b[-1] == 'X', (list(b)[-3:], r[-3:])
print('ok: insert(len) at end')

b.insert(0, 'Y'); r.insert(0, 'Y')
assert list(b) == r, (list(b)[:3], r[:3])
print('ok: insert(0)')

b.insert(50000, 'Z'); r.insert(50000, 'Z')
assert list(b) == r
print('ok: insert interior')

# negative insert
b.insert(-1, 'W'); r.insert(-1, 'W')
assert list(b) == r
print('ok: insert(-1)')
print('ALL PASS')
"

observations.command:
cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace python -c "
from boltons.listutils import BarrelList

b = BarrelList(range(100000)); b.pop(50000)
r = list(range(100000)); r.pop(50000)
b.lists.append([]); b.lists.append([])
assert b.pop() == r.pop()
assert list(b) == r
assert b.lists[-1], 'tail should be non-empty after cleanup'
print('ok: pop() cleans empty tail sublists')

b.lists.append([]); b.lists.append([])
assert b.pop(len(b)-1) == r.pop(len(r)-1)
assert list(b) == r
print('ok: pop(len-1) with empty tail sublists')

b.lists.append([])
assert b.pop(0) == r.pop(0)
assert list(b) == r
print('ok: pop(0) with empty tail sublist')

# multiple empty tails then pop(0) (interior branch must also clean tails)
b.lists.append([]); b.lists.append([])
assert b.pop(10) == r.pop(10)
assert list(b) == r and b.lists[-1]
print('ok: pop(interior) cleans empty tail sublists')
print('ALL PASS')
"
